exposure.needed: whether the AMIs the environment's node classes resolve to are non-AL2023 (the resolved AMI identities behind the environment's AMI selection are not visible in static configuration)

original.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 updates AMIFamily for non-AL2023 AMIs (bugfix #6638), so environments that use non-AL2023 AMIs will see changed AMIFamily handling after upgrading.

decision.reason: The linked PR and commit change only two files, both test code: test/pkg/environment/aws/environment.go and test/suites/drift/suite_test.go [ev-b10097ad63d2][ev-af1646dba20c]. The PR says it has no docs impact [ev-8d60e1cd9157]. This is a change to the E2E test harness, not to shipped product behaviour, so no customer environment is exposed. The proposed undecidable leaf is also not allowed here: it uses a reason outside the allowed set ("environment-visibility-gap") to cover what is really a configuration-visibility concern.
